title: Fruit Friends – Colours & Counting 1 to 10 – Narrated Learning Video for Babies & Toddlers
thumbnailText: Colours & Counting | with the Fruit Friends
hook: 12 minutes of colours, counting 1 to 10 and shapes for 6–24 months: slow narrated flashcards with a 3-second pause after every card so your little one can answer, and Fruit Friends dance breaks in between (Twinkle, Old MacDonald, London Bridge). Watch together and say the words back.
diff: The only narrated LEARN flagship: three flashcard lessons (colours, numbers 1–10, shapes) read by the narrator with a deliberate 3-second answer pause after each card, alternating with three Fruit Friends dance loops that grow the cast from 5 to 7 characters. Its concept (call-and-response learning), scene mix (flashcards + dancing-fruits), tempo (94 BPM lessons / 108–112 BPM dance) and melody set (Mary, Row, Frère Jacques under the lessons; Twinkle, Old MacDonald, London Bridge under the dances) are not used by any other flagship; the newborn, bubbles and lullaby episodes have no narration at all, and the rhyme and story episodes narrate verse and prose rather than lesson cards.

segments.caption: Made just for your little one
